family: The single total certificate-prefix language specified in proof.md and family.py. For actual length N, choose k as the least prime at least the least positive B with B^5>((27+18sqrt(2))/64)*N^3, decided exactly by g=64B^5-27N^3>0 and g^2>648N^6; read k input bits as the lower coefficients of a monic degree-k polynomial Q over F_2, reject invalid Q by the exact Frobenius/gcd test, and evaluate the descending-power BK symmetric polynomial on the remaining N-k bits with zero padding, r=ceil((N-k)/k), t=ceil(sqrt(r)). Output 0 for N=0 or the explicit failed guards in proof.md. The output is the constant coefficient in F_2[Z]/Q. All k prefix bits are included in N; Q is input, not advice.
theorem: For the one total uniform polynomial-time certificate-prefix family specified in proof.md and family.py with c=(27+18sqrt(2))/64 and length rule B^5>c*N^3, C_B2(F_N)>=4N-3k-8d_N+7 at every sufficiently large integer N. Put W=r(r+3)/2, H=(t-1)(t+2)/2, A0=(t-1)k-H-(r-t+1), L=floor(t*k/(t+1)-t/2), q=floor(L/t), a=L-t*q, B_int=r*q+a, B_joint=r*(2k-r-1)/(2*(t+1)), and d_N=1+W+max(A0,min(B_int,floor(B_joint))). The complete disperser proof needs prime k>r+1, verified in disperser.md Section15; the evaluator explicitly enforces this weaker guard. All guards and k>=t(t+1)/2 hold eventually, k=Theta(N^(3/5)), and eventually d_N=1+W+A0=(t-1)k+(r*(r+1)-t*(t-1))/2+1. Consequently liminf over ALL integer N of C_B2(F_N)/N>=4. More precisely put b=c^(1/5) and M=sqrt(b)+1/(2*b^2). For every epsilon>0, C_B2(F_N)>=4N-(8M+epsilon)*N^(4/5) at every sufficiently large integer N; the proved remainder R_N=3k+8d_N-7 has limsup R_N/N^(4/5)<=8M<8*sqrt(2)+1. This is a certified uniform remainder envelope for this single new family, not a pointwise complexity comparison with another language. The generic additive-seven theorem for d>=3 uses exactly the four normalized R84 refutations and complete Q7 coverage executed by audit.py, with complete normalization and unrestricted-sharing transfer in elimination.md. Every prefix bit is eventually essential and fixing an accepted prefix with nonconstant residual removes at least k gates in the strengthened signed-wire/output-literal model. All field, prefix, dispersion, guard and all-length arguments are supplied. No prime number theorem or conjectural gap hypothesis is used.
